title: Olivia E NDE 7342/8294
content: 8294: This is from my journal - In the 1950s, a baby girl was born to a man and wife who already had 4 children. The husband was a hard-core, 'old world' kind of man who loved his children. The wife loved sex with her husband, but not the consequences of becoming pregnant. The wife, being resentful of being burdened, yet again, with a baby. She brought the baby home and immediately gave complete responsibility for the baby girl's care over to her nine year old sister. The child was charged with an adult responsibility. Soon after giving birth, the mother came down with the flu. As she recovered, the baby girl had also contracted this flu. She lay in her crib, burning up with fever. Her eyes were sunken in and she was severely dehydrated and near death. No one bothered to check on the baby until her father came home from work. In a panic, he told the oldest 9 year old daughter to get the baby dressed. She held her baby sister while the father drove as fast as he could to the emergency room. What happened on the way, that dark night, is what the baby experienced. She was 6 weeks old. Darkness. She opened her eyes. She thought she was on the lap of her mother. She lay with her feet pointing towards the passenger door. When she opened her eyes, a little row of lights were moving from left to right and danced across her eyes just above her line of sight. The baby thought, 'what IS THAT?' More lights came. Again, the lights were moving left to right. The lights fascinated the baby, but watching them made her so sleepy. She closed her eyes, unable to keep them open. She opened her eyes again and turned her face upward. Her mother's chin was directly above her. She saw that her mother was wearing a head scarf that was tied in a knot underneath her chin. It was a white or light-colored scarf with big dark polka dots on it. The baby felt so weak, so tired and drained. She could not look for long and soon closed her eyes again. This time, something happened. The baby girl opened her eyes and found she was floating up, near the ceiling. She was in the darkness of the backseat directly behind her father's head as he drove the car. The baby saw the bright dashboard lights. They were so bright that they almost blinded her. She instinctively looked down at herself but did not see the rest of her body. It was as if she were somehow invisible. She saw a person, who she was sure was her mother, sitting in the front passenger seat. She also saw right through the seat that her mother was holding something on her lap. Then the baby started 'feeling' all the emotions that people in the car were feeling. Her father was very afraid and panicking inside. He was filled with urgency, very upset, and overwhelmed. While the emotions coming from her sister, who she thought was her mom, were far more subdued. The mom felt no urgency, no fear, and not much of anything except worrying about the father. Then the baby heard the mom say something that affected the father. He jerked his head over and turned the big steering wheel to the right. Then he leaned over to examine the bundle on the mom's lap by reaching his arm up to it. That's when the baby felt a big WHOOSH. Then she felt an absolute heaviness, with heat pulsating throughout her body. Then there was darkness. She opened her eyes and saw her father's face directly above hers, upside down. His eyes were wide open. After that, the baby stopped remembering any of the event. Years later, as a young adult, the older sister began to tell of what happened that night many years before. The now-grown baby girl's eyes flew wide open and she gave her older sister the details. The older sister did not want to believe her and dismissed it. She asked her what happened at the hospital. It turns out that the emergency doctors ALL told her and the father that it was a miracle the baby was still alive. She had gotten to the emergency room just in time. That baby girl? She was me. Two years later, I had another NDE. Only THAT time, I saw my guardian Angel who communicated with me. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 1956 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Illness. Life threatening event, but not clinical death. I was severely dehydrated and feverish How do you consider the content of your experience? Both pleasant AND distressing The experience included: Out of body experience Did you feel separated from your body? Yes. No one knew that I was there in a different, invisible way. I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. The light was BRIGHTER, and more VIVID. I could literally 'FEEL' what the others were feeling, as though super-amplified. I was completely at peace and lighter than air. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? While I was out of body Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Time seemed to go faster or slower than usual. It seemed that everything was in slow motion Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. EVERYTHING was more intense Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Hearing was perfect. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Yes, and the facts have been checked out Did you pass into or through a a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No The experience included: Strong emotional tone What emotions did you feel during the experience? bewilderment and awe Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt no longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about myself or others. I was not an infant in my mind. I was able to understand far more than anyone would imagine a 6-week old baby could and I don't know how that was possible. Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of No return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What importance did you place on your religious/spiritual life prior to your experience? Unknown What was your religion prior to your experience? Do not know. I was just a baby and no religion was introduced yet. Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What importance do you place on your religious/spiritual life after your experience? Greatly important to me What is your religion now? Christian- Protestant Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. Not applicable because I was only 6 weeks old Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes. I am deeply devoted to GOD because I know now, HE IS MORE REAL THAN HUMANS CAN KNOW IN OUR PRESENT PHYSICAL FORM!! Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes I seemed to understand that 'I' was invisible and in spirit-form Did you believe in the existence of God prior to your experience? Unknown During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Do you believe in the existence of God after your experience? God definitely exists Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes I was aware I was changed. In my previous outlook before, there was significantly more awareness in how I was all of a sudden, as if advanced. Did you believe that our earthly lives Are meaningful and significant prior to your experience? Unknown During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No Did you believe in an afterlife prior to your experience? Unknown Do you believe in an afterlife after your experience? An afterlife definitely exists No Did you fear death prior to your experience? Unknown Do you fear death after your experience? I do not fear death Were you fearful living your life prior to your experience? Unknown Were you fearful living your life after your experience? Not fearful in living my earthly life Did you believe that our earthly lives Are meaningful and significant prior to your experience? Unknown Did you believe that our earthly lives are meaningful and significant after your experience? Are meaningful and significant Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No Were you compassionate prior to your experience? Unknown During your experience, did you gain information about love? No Were you compassionate after your experience? Greatly compassionate toward others What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life. I am HIGHLY sensitive to everyone and everything. I have incredible empathic abilities and there is no on-and-off switch. I have a SOLID memory that might be describe as photographic. I always feel what others feel. I am a highly VIVID dreamer and I have had recurring dreams, one that saved my life. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes I am intensely empathic. It's as if I am plugged into people whether I like it or not. I have a very intense memory, my dreams are highly vivid, and I have had other encounters that God was very much a part of. So have my children. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I was an adult when I finally discovered where the memories of me as a baby came from. My whole childhood, I knew I was different. Any time I have ever shared my NDEs, they get quiet. All of sudden, I realize they must have thought I was out of my mind. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. I had images of memory from both NDEs. But until I was an adult, I couldn't say what I was remembering or where these happenings belonged. I was very different than my family and other kids. I was always told negative things about me and many statements that I must be mentally ill. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? I haven't ever heard of anyone ever having an NDE as an infant and I realize how crazy that sounds.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Described being "completely at peace and lighter than air."

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt a big "WHOOSH," then "absolute heaviness, with heat pulsating throughout" and then was back seeing her father's face above her.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Flu with severe dehydration and fever at 6 weeks old; taken to emergency room.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Transitional darkness and moving dashboard/road lights; empathic sensing of others' emotions; sudden "WHOOSH" and return to body.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experience emphasized darkness/lights and an out-of-body vantage in the car rather than tunnel/otherworld; no boundary; abrupt return with a "WHOOSH."

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: NDE reported at 6 weeks old; described seeing through the car seat and strongly "feeling" others' emotions (super-amplified) while out of body; later memory confirmation attempt in adulthood.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: Felt a big "WHOOSH." Then she felt an absolute heaviness, with heat pulsating throughout her body.
